assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: Clean-room authorship is mandatory; no proprietary EA source, decompiled source, assets, models, textures, sounds, or scripts are copied into OpenSpore.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: This is a legal, ethical, and repository-wide invariant.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: SPORE is a read-only, user-owned oracle input and remains ignored; tools may inspect metadata or bounded runtime evidence but must not write into it.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: Runtime and asset tooling is explicitly separated from the OpenSpore runtime.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: Current source and tests establish OpenSpore implementation behavior only; they do not by themselves establish original-game semantics.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: The repository repeatedly labels decompilation as evidence, not truth, and separates OpenSpore fixtures from live original behavior.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: The canonical evidence scale is UNKNOWN < APPROXIMATION < INFERRED < SUPPORTED < OBSERVED < CONFIRMED < VERIFIED; replacement status is a separate nine-value vocabulary.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: The current KG, dossier, and status tools use the canonical mapping.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: Simulation determinism is fixed-step, no-time/no-rand, and same-host/toolchain scoped; cross-platform libm behavior is not promised.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: The contract and replay tests pin the local contract, not original runtime timing.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: The current compatibility seams B1/B2/B3 are intentionally narrow and should be extended rather than duplicated.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: The seams isolate resource, mesh, and renderer concepts from original implementation details.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: Unsupported formats and structures fail explicitly instead of being silently accepted.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: The parsers validate bounds, versions, record accounting, and documented layouts.

assumptions_to_preserve.assumption: Shared display/GPU work serializes through the machine lock, and runtime trace/status/fixture rebuild writes remain human-gated.
assumptions_to_preserve.reason: The safety and lock contracts are implemented and tested in the tooling.

semantic_gaps.gap: Forward/strafe/boost/turn/damping, camera fov/orbit constants, and keyboard-secondary weighting are not original observed values.
Eat/flee radius, damage, target selection, timing, and event ordering are inferred from animation/resource names.
Movement-plane normal is statically pinned to {0,0,1}; the per-world point is load-time {0,0,0} but runtime value is unread.
CellGame, pool, query, advect, and combat components are not integrated into the live CellSim frame loop.
B1 does not model multi-package selection, directory records, caching, or original load order.
Scene positions and role assignments are declarative approximations; procedural world/populate execution is absent.
GMDL v9, 32-bit indices, non-trilist, multi-stream, animation, and complete RW4 sections are not implemented.
WorldObject parser accounts for bytes and extracts names/vectors but does not derive per-entry field order or placement semantics.
Lighting/material values are fixed-function approximations and no original frame exists for pixel matching.
AppSystem bootstrap, UTFWin dispatch, editor, creature/tribe/civ/space stages, properties, audio, Havok, and original input are not implemented.
No successful Cell-mode trace has been recorded; main-menu traces are negative or capped before Cell Stage.
